fluff.overview: Com Guard conventional infantry benefit from ComStar's access to preserved Star League technology, fielding weapons and equipment that match or exceed the standard issue of any Inner Sphere military, backed by the institutional discipline of the secular Order's professional military culture. Jump infantry Level I formations provide the vertical mobility needed to operate in urban environments and mountainous terrain. Com Guard jump troops train to exploit three-dimensional movement as a tactical advantage, clearing rooftops and elevated positions that conventional foot infantry cannot reach without significant delay. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
